outputs.name: hero-v4-run-readable-a
outputs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / lighting-weather. FIRST image is the EXACT RUN ATLAS EDIT TARGET. SECOND image is the approved IDLE-READABLE colour, material and neutral lighting standard. Edit ONLY colour values, material shading and light/dark separation of the running people in FIRST image to match SECOND. Do not redesign body or pose. Palette: clearly readable muted teal/blue-green short cape, DARK COOL BROWN leather cuirass with restrained grain and stitches, gray-brown/charcoal-taupe trousers, ivory WHITE linen sleeves with clean neutral highlights, neutral silver brushed steel pauldron and blade. Skin natural neutral warm but never orange or pale wax; hair dark brown curls. Same skin brightness/contrast and same clothing hue/value/material in ALL16 frames and both run halves. No whole-character gold tint, no yellow trousers, no red/orange studio light, no plastic shine. Like readable idle, chest leather is darker than sleeves and cape has distinct cool blue-green midtones, helping separate from brown wooden ground.
STRICT GEOMETRY INVARIANTS: preserve every original pixel-level silhouette, exact adult body proportions, head/hair size and curl outline, face identity and eye/nose/mouth positions, torso, shoulders, waistline, hip height, thigh/shin lengths, knees, feet, fingers, sword grip and the complete straight sword length/angle. Do not shrink heads or lengthen legs. Do not change camera or scale. Preserve all sixteen original run phase poses, their supporting foot/raised boot, anatomical side and lower-body overlap. Preserve original cell layout, exact body centre positions and ground positions; no horizontal/vertical drift or recentering, no crop/reflow. These are local paint/material edits only. Do not convert run into idle or walking from SECOND image.
Canvas EXACT1024x1536 RGBA, portrait4COLUMNS x4ROWS,256x384 cells, rows down/front,right,up/back,left, same four time phases from FIRST image. Full bodies and sword tips remain in original cells. Actual alpha0 transparent empty background, remove all true fog/vignette/matte/floor/shadows; no text, labels, grid or checkerboard. Keep clean opaque characters and neutral consistent illumination. No changes to equipment design. Same W01 thin straight steel blade/iron crossguard/brown leather grip; only its material becomes neutral steel as readable idle.
Main result: approved readable-idle colours and tactile material values on EXACT same RUN drawings, with no geometry or animation changes, and no head enlargement/normalization.
A is the right-support first half. Keep its front screen-left supporting boot and back screen-right support. Do not swap phase.
